cert-lifecycle-harness 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a rigorous assistant workflow for managing the full lifecycle of X.509/TLS certificates in complex infrastructures, including renewal, replacement, and migration.
- Enforces a strict role: agent acts as safety officer, document engineer, and trusted executor—never as an autonomous SRE.
- Mandates a six-gate protocol before any write APIs (Import/Modify) are executed; Delete operations are never executed, only script-generated.
- Implements complexity-based workflow splits (Fast/Standard/Full paths) with clear criteria for each, ensuring tailored processes for various infrastructures.
- Adapts asset discovery to graph closure models, supporting wildcard, cross-zone, and provenance tracking.
- Aligns processes with the CA/B Forum’s upcoming certificate validity reductions and requires all outputs (scripts, reviews, runbooks) to be delivered as standalone files for auditability.
